channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Greatai Review: Free AI Code Review for Open Source
